Split PDF

Pull out just the pages you need, remove the ones you don't, or break a PDF into separate files. Enter page numbers like 1-3, 5, 8-10, or split every page or every few pages into a ZIP.

How to use Split PDF

  1. Drop a PDF into the box.
  2. Choose to extract pages, remove pages, or split into separate files.
  3. Enter the pages, such as 1-3, 5, 8-10.
  4. Click the button and download the result.

Frequently asked questions

How do I write the page numbers?

Use commas and dashes: 1-3, 5, 8-10 means pages 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 9 and 10.

Can I split every page into its own file?

Yes. Choose 'Split into separate files' and set 1 page per file. You get a ZIP of single-page PDFs.

Is my PDF uploaded?

No. It is processed in your browser.
